title: People First
headline: Bring one decision.
intro: Choose a decision your team makes often. These three sheets will help you map what happens today, sketch what the person deciding needs to see, and plan a small test.
note: Use them with the person who does the work. Paper and a pen are enough. Use fictional examples or remove identifying details.

sheets.title: Map one decision
sheets.intro: Start with a specific moment: approving an application, making a referral, or asking for more information.
prompts: The decision
What needs to be decided? Where does this part of the process begin and end?
People
Who does the work? Who is affected? Who can resolve an exception?
Process
What happens today? Mark the handoffs, repeated work and moments of uncertainty.
Information
What facts are needed? Where do they come from? What is missing or sensitive?
Decisions
What follows an approved rule? Where could AI help? What must a person decide?

sheets.title: Sketch the evidence view
sheets.intro: Draw what the person needs to see before deciding. A rough sketch is useful. Nobody is grading the drawing.
prompts: Before any suggestion
Which facts, sources, conflicts and gaps should be visible first?
Make room for judgment
Where can the person record an initial view, ask for more information or disagree?
Correct and continue
How can they open a source, correct a fact and choose the next action?

sheets.title: Plan a small test
sheets.intro: Try your sketch with the person who does the work. Start with three fictional cases: ordinary, conflicting evidence, and missing information.
prompts: The test
What will you try? Who will take part, and when?
What to observe
Can the person find the relevant facts and spot a mistake? What takes effort?
When to pause
What would make you stop? Who can pause the test? How will the work continue manually?
What happened
What confused the reviewer? What did they change or ask for?
The next step
What will you change? Who owns that change, and when will you review it?

workshopText: In the workshop, you bring a process from your own work. We use these sheets, compare ideas in small groups, and work through the tricky parts together. I move between the groups to help you make the next step concrete.
slideBody: Three sheets to use with your team.
slideSteps: Map it. Sketch it. Try it.
